title: Nailed to the Cross
summary: May it never become normal to us that God nailed himself to the cross we deserved, to rescue his enemies and cancel our debt.
exhortation: I grew up in a Christian home, so I find it helpful to remember sometimes how astonishing and otherworldly Christianity is: that our God would be nailed to the cross we deserved, that he would come to rescue his enemies, and that he would cancel our debt by shedding his own blood.
May this truth never become normal or boring to us. May we be astonished at the mercy, grace and love of Jesus again and again.
prayer: Lord, as we continue this day and this week, guard our hearts and fill us with your Spirit as we go to work, to school and everything else we're doing. Be part of it all. Let us feel your presence, give us boldness, and let us experience your love deeply so we can share it with others.
Help us be confident in your love, God. Thank you for the words of truth you've given us in your word. Let them dwell richly in us. In Jesus' name, amen.
